version: kit_v1_2 (based on kit_v1_1; only kit_rock_s/m/l changed)
orientation: origin at base centre at ground level, front faces +Z, Y up; FBX export axis_forward=-Z axis_up=Y scale 1
scenery_note: ALL meshes are scenery only: set CanCollide=false (and CanQuery/CanTouch false), Anchored=true. None are gameplay surfaces.

rock_tones_rgb.note: kit_v1_1 rock bodies already used exactly these three palette cells; v1_2 keeps them. The tan came from the SandTop/SandTopLt cap shells.

changes: Cap shells (the tan SandTop/SandTopLt layers) now split by ring: upper part moss in LeafLt/LeafGreen/LeafDk, lowest band cave rock. Sand kept only on the lowest band of one small rock in kit_rock_m and one in kit_rock_l.
Added small fern tufts (2 s, 3 m, 5 l) on the shoulders of the smaller rocks, inside the original bbox.
Geometry, jitter, rng stream, pivots, sizes and burial depth identical to kit_v1_1 (asserted in gen_kit12.py).

kit_palm_s.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0, base at y=0
kit_palm_s.suggested_use: Short palm for beach pads (target ~25 high).

kit_palm_m.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0, base at y=0
kit_palm_m.suggested_use: Medium palm, shoulders the pad palms (target ~40 high).

kit_palm_l.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0, base at y=0
kit_palm_l.suggested_use: Tall palm for skyline and jungle edges (target ~60 high).

kit_palm_lean_a.pivot: trunk base at x=z=0, y=0 (lean palm: placed by its trunk)
kit_palm_lean_a.suggested_use: Leaning palm: crown leans toward +Z (front). Origin is the trunk base.

kit_palm_lean_b.pivot: trunk base at x=z=0, y=0 (lean palm: placed by its trunk)
kit_palm_lean_b.suggested_use: Leaning palm: crown leans toward +X. Origin is the trunk base.

kit_stack_c.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0, base at y=0
